title: Marriage Customs
summary: Marriage customs involved family arrangements, betrothal, celebration, household honor, and covenant responsibility.
background: Biblical marriage scenes often reflect social customs that differ from modern Western patterns. Betrothal, processions, feasts, and family negotiations help explain many narrative details.
teachingHelp: Use marriage-background notes to clarify the scene, then point to faithfulness, covenant, and the biblical image of Christ and His people where the passage supports it.
